title: Letter No. 926 — reply concerning a scheduled meeting and an allusion to the year 5711
response_propositions: The writer asks to be informed of favorable results from a scheduled meeting so that he may share the recipient's joy.
The response connects the Torah phrase about raising the heads of Israel with a letter-play allusion to the Hebrew year 5711.
It justifies the allusion through the traditional principle that a word's received reading can support interpretation even when a letter is not written.
